title: An in-process smoke tester with httpx.AsyncClient
problem: Write smoke(app, paths, concurrency): send a GET to every path of a FastAPI app in-process (httpx.AsyncClient with httpx.ASGITransport, no server), at most `concurrency` requests at a time, and return {path: status_code}. The tests are AnyIO async tests: read them as worked examples of @pytest.mark.anyio.
requirements: Use one httpx.AsyncClient wired to the app with httpx.ASGITransport for all requests
Run the requests concurrently, at most `concurrency` at a time, and use the limit fully
A handler that raises an exception is reported as 500, not raised
Keys follow the order of `paths`; duplicate paths are requested once
contract: async def smoke(app: FastAPI, paths: list[str], concurrency: int) -> dict[str, int]
expectedBehavior: smoke(app, ['/ok/1', '/missing', '/nope'], 3) returns {'/ok/1': 200, '/missing': 404, '/nope': 404}; smoke(app, ['/crash', '/ok/2'], 2) returns {'/crash': 500, '/ok/2': 200}; with 10 paths and concurrency 4 the app sees a peak of exactly 4 requests in flight.
edgeCases: concurrency == 1: one request at a time; concurrency 0: ValueError
Duplicate paths: requested once, key kept in first-seen position
hints: Conceptual: ASGITransport lets an AsyncClient talk to the app object directly, inside your event loop. By default it re-raises handler exceptions; it has an option to return the 500 response instead.

Specific: build `httpx.ASGITransport(app=app, raise_app_exceptions=False)`, open `httpx.AsyncClient(transport=..., base_url="http://test")` with async with, and reuse the semaphore + gather pattern from AS.M02.L04.

Implementation: validate concurrency, dedupe with dict.fromkeys, then inside the async with define `async def status(path)` that acquires the semaphore and returns `(await client.get(path)).status_code`; gather those and zip with the unique paths.
evaluation: One client, closed via async with
No real network or server used
The learner can explain what raise_app_exceptions changes and why tests usually keep the default
